workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.summary: The sidebar shows the current workspace, task threads, capability entries, and search; when collapsed it keeps a 64px icon rail.

bullets.0: The primary button at the top jumps straight into a conversation with a new task.
bullets.1: Threads are grouped by Pinned / Today / This week / Earlier and collapsed by default to reduce visual noise.
bullets.2: Capability entries (Agents / Skills / Knowledge / Memory / Automations / Settings) open the ModulePage on click; clicking again keeps it open.
bullets.3: The sidebar width is draggable between 64–320px.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.summary: A task is the smallest unit of collaboration in ArkWork: one task = a conversation + plan + file context + step history.

bullets.0: The Composer focuses automatically after creating a task; pressing Enter starts the first round, and the title is auto-generated from the first message.
bullets.1: The ⋯ menu on each Thread row supports rename, run / stop, favorite, and delete.
bullets.2: Failed or cancelled steps can be re-run individually; message and file history is preserved.
bullets.3: Per-task knowledge-base toggle: each task can enable KB search independently (without relying on the global setting).

parallel.title: Parallel execution
parallel.summary: Independent tool calls run in parallel automatically; progress is shown per tool without overwriting each other.

bullets.0: A single Agent inference can trigger multiple tool calls, which the engine executes concurrently.
bullets.1: Operations with dependencies (write-then-read) still run serially to avoid race conditions.
bullets.2: The plan card and the right-side list share the same planItems source, preventing premature ticking.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.summary: The conversation stream carries user messages, plans, tool results, and Agent replies; it is scrollable and can lock focus.

bullets.0: User messages and Agent replies are stacked in reverse chronological order; tool calls appear as collapsible cards.
bullets.1: While an Agent is running, human-readable descriptions like "running command…" appear at the top of the conversation (mapped by tool type).
bullets.2: The Composer supports multi-line input; long tasks can be paused, resumed, or cancelled.

actions.1: Create a task to start a conversation

agents.title: Agents
agents.summary: An Agent = personality + default model + enabled skills + Dock preferences. Agents can be created, edited, and duplicated.

bullets.0: The Agents page lists all agents, each with an icon, personality summary, model, enabled skill count, and Dock preset.
bullets.1: Create / edit opens the AgentEditor form: personality prompt, default model, available skills, and Dock layout.
bullets.2: Switching agents auto-applies their Dock preferences; a hint bar briefly appears in the status bar.

skills.title: Skills (Built-in / Marketplace / Imported)
skills.summary: Skills are grouped by source into three sets, each with its own badge and count; import sources are traceable.

bullets.0: Built-in: ArkWork's own skills, cannot be deleted; used for basics like shell, file reading, and KB queries.
bullets.1: Marketplace: skills installed from SkillHub, can be updated / removed; installed items appear in the Installed area of the Marketplace tab.
bullets.2: Imported: skills from local file imports or external MCP integrations, with a source field.
bullets.3: When importing from a zip, the entire zip contents (all .md and subdirectory files) are extracted into the Skill folder.

kb.title: Knowledge base
kb.summary: Parses PDF / TXT / Markdown / DOCX into searchable text (SQLite FTS5); the kb_query tool returns matched passages.

bullets.0: Supports parsing / indexed / failed states; failed documents can be retried in one click on the KB page.
bullets.1: Provides a two-layer KB toggle (session-level + global-level); when off, kb-search is not injected into context and no restart is needed.
bullets.2: Matched passages can be viewed in the Inspector's Context and Files panels.

memory.title: Memory L1 – L4
memory.summary: ArkWork maintains four layers of memory with automatic distillation; the raw layer is cleaned up automatically.

bullets.0: L1 working memory: temporary entries within the current conversation context.
bullets.1: L2 file memory: facts, quotes, and command records extracted within a conversation.
bullets.2: L3 curated memory: topics / reusable passages across conversations, searchable and injectable.
bullets.3: L4 identity memory: long-term user preferences and persona, updated slowly.
bullets.4: When thresholds are met (topic count / reuse rate / L2 size), distillation runs automatically; the manual "move to knowledge base" UI has been removed.

automations.title: Automations
automations.summary: Agent tasks triggered by schedule or manually; supports alarm-style frequency picker plus custom cron.

bullets.0: Create / edit / delete on the Automations page; triggered tasks enter the task queue.
bullets.1: Execution results are written back to the corresponding task's conversation for easy review.
bullets.2: The running status of automations is reflected in real time by the "Running" indicator at the bottom-right of the status bar.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.summary: Five fixed tabs on the right: Todos / Context / Files / Logs / Browser.

bullets.0: Clicking the active tab again collapses it; after collapsing, clicking any tab re-expands it (no more "stuck" state).
bullets.1: Todos: syncs planItems in real time; a single source of truth.
bullets.2: Context: read-only view of the KB / memory snippets and token budget injected into the current task; editable from L2 in the memory center.
bullets.3: Files: workspace file browser (the fake "favorite" button has been removed).
bullets.4: Logs: tool call / permission / error stream; copyable in one click.
bullets.5: Browser: embedded BrowserPanel links with PreviewWindow.

models.title: Models / Settings
models.summary: Settings page has five sections: Models / Workspace / Appearance / Shortcuts / Advanced.

bullets.0: Models: choose default / fallback models and configure API keys; supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and local Ollama.
bullets.1: Workspace: choose the workspace root, default KB, and file ignore rules.
bullets.2: Appearance: theme (light / dark / system) + font density.
bullets.3: Shortcuts: a read-only list of all current shortcuts (synced with HelpCenter).
bullets.4: Advanced: experimental toggles, log level, auto-update channel.
bullets.5: The current model is shown only in the Composer; other locations (TopBar / StatusBar / task header) have been consolidated.

privacy.title: Privacy / Local Storage
privacy.summary: ArkWork is local-first by default: tasks / conversations / memory are stored as local JSON, and knowledge-base indexes live in local SQLite (FTS5) and the filesystem.

bullets.0: Data directory: in development userData is redirected to app/.dev-data; in packaged builds it lives in the system userData (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/ArkWork).
bullets.1: The app data root is {userData}/arkwork-data: tasks / agents / skills / models / memory are all persisted there as JSON.
bullets.2: Current workspace: {userData}/arkwork-data/workspace/default (switchable under Settings · Workspace); task memory lives at {workspaceDir}/.arkwork/memory/{taskId}.
bullets.3: Model calls are made using API keys you explicitly configure; ArkWork never uploads your conversation content.
bullets.4: Export or clear workspace data in one click; all changes can be found under Settings → Advanced.
